subject: Middle School Transition
overview: Fifth-grade students from Mr. Cormier's class at Roberts Elementary School interviewed middle school principals and sixth-grade students to prepare for their transition to middle school. The students also shared favorite elementary school memories and offered advice to rising fifth graders.

items.title: McGlynn Middle School Q&A
items.summary: McGlynn Middle School Principal Nick Tucci and sixth-grade students answered fifth-grader questions about navigating multi-teacher schedules, joining extracurricular clubs, and adapting to academic expectations.

items.title: Andrews Middle School Q&A
items.summary: Andrews Middle School Principal Michael Downs and sixth-grade students addressed questions regarding middle school homework, moving between classrooms, and core school values.

items.title: Elementary School Reflections
items.summary: Fifth graders from Mr. Cormier's class shared favorite elementary memories, including gym parachute games, field trips, class presentations, and making new friends.

items.title: Advice for Rising Fifth Graders
items.summary: Roberts Elementary fifth graders offered guidance to incoming fifth graders on handling schoolwork, managing nerves, and participating in student council.
